Gangtok: NJP / Bagdogra → Rangpo → Singtam → Gangtok → sightseeing → departure

An easy first-time Sikkim stay based in Gangtok. The Teesta-valley approach, MG Marg, monasteries and city viewpoints make it suitable for couples, families and groups, with optional East Sikkim excursions.
09:00–17:00 — Breakfast, then Tashi View Point, Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok and Enchey Monastery; lunch at a local restaurant; return to Gangtok for dinner.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast and either Rumtek/monastery sightseeing or the permit-based Tsomgo circuit; return to Gangtok for dinner.
Nathula & Tsomgo: NJP / Bagdogra → Gangtok → Tsomgo Lake → Baba Mandir → Nathula → Gangtok

A high-altitude East Sikkim circuit combining Gangtok with Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir and Nathula Pass. Nathula/Tsomgo access is permit- and weather-dependent, so the final route is confirmed after permit processing.
09:00–17:00 — Breakfast and Gangtok sightseeing at Tashi View Point, Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok and Enchey; evening at MG Marg.
06:00–16:00 — Early breakfast/tea, then permit-based Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir and Nathula Pass if open; return to Gangtok.
Tsomgo Lake: NJP / Bagdogra → Gangtok → Tsomgo Lake → Baba Mandir → Gangtok
A short East Sikkim break centred on Gangtok and the famous Tsomgo Lake. It is designed for travellers with limited time who still want the high-altitude lake and Baba Mandir experience.
06:30–16:00 — Breakfast/tea and permit-based Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir excursion; Nathula only if separately permitted; return to Gangtok.
Old Silk Route: NJP / Bagdogra → Aritar → Rongli → Zuluk → Nathang → Kupup → Gangtok

A dedicated Old Silk Route road journey through Aritar, Rongli and Zuluk into the high valleys of Nathang and Kupup. Local homestays, sunrise viewpoints and mountain villages make it very different from a standard Gangtok holiday.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Rongli permit/checkpoint formalities and drive to Zuluk/Padamchen with village and mountain stops; homestay dinner.
05:00–17:00 — Sunrise at Thambi View Point, then Lungthung, Nathang Valley and Kupup when roads are open; return to the homestay.
Silk Route: NJP / Bagdogra → Aritar → Zuluk → Nathang → Kupup → Gangtok

A slower Silk Route option for travellers who want more time in eastern Sikkim. Aritar, Zuluk, Thambi, Nathang and Kupup are linked with village stays and sunrise viewpoints before returning towards Gangtok.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Rongli checkpoint and onward drive to Zuluk/Padamchen; photography stops and local homestay.
05:00–17:00 — Sunrise at Thambi, then Lungthung, Nathang and Kupup where access is permitted; return to the route homestay.
Rumtek & Monasteries: NJP / Bagdogra → Gangtok → Rumtek → Enchey → local monasteries

A culture-focused Gangtok trip for travellers who prefer monasteries, viewpoints and local life over long high-altitude drives. Rumtek is the main excursion, supported by Enchey, Do Drul Chorten and MG Marg.
09:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Rumtek Monastery excursion, then Enchey Monastery, Do Drul Chorten and city viewpoints; return for dinner.
North Sikkim: NJP / Bagdogra → Gangtok → Lachung → Yumthang → Zero Point → Gangtok

A classic North Sikkim itinerary built around Lachung and Yumthang Valley, with Gangtok as the gateway. The high mountain route is permit-controlled and weather-sensitive, so sightseeing order can change after local confirmation.
07:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Gangtok sightseeing and permit/document preparation before the North Sikkim drive; dinner in Gangtok.
07:00–17:00 — Early breakfast and Gangtok → Mangan → Chungthang → Lachung, with waterfalls and Teesta-valley stops; dinner in Lachung.
Lachung & Yumthang: NJP / Bagdogra → Gangtok → Lachung → Yumthang → Zero Point → Gangtok
A focused Lachung and Yumthang package without the Lachen/Gurudongmar circuit. The highlight is the alpine Yumthang Valley, with Zero Point added when permits and road conditions allow.
07:00–17:00 — Breakfast and early drive through Mangan and Chungthang to Lachung; waterfall and mountain stops; check in and dinner.
05:30–16:00 — Early breakfast/tea, Yumthang Valley and Zero Point when open; return to Lachung for dinner.
Lachen & Gurudongmar: NJP / Bagdogra → Gangtok → Lachen → Thangu → Gurudongmar → Lachung/Yumthang

A demanding high-altitude circuit combining Lachen, Thangu and Gurudongmar Lake with the Lachung/Yumthang side. The itinerary uses early starts and rest periods because altitude, permits and road clearance can change the plan.
06:30–17:00 — Breakfast and drive through Mangan and Chungthang to Lachen; check in early and keep the evening for rest.
04:30–15:00 — Early Lachen → Thangu → Chopta Valley → Gurudongmar Lake if permitted; return to Lachen for rest and dinner.
Lachen Village: NJP / Bagdogra → Gangtok → Lachen → Thangu/Chopta Valley → Gangtok

A Lachen-focused package for travellers who want the quieter North Sikkim village experience. It includes the road through Mangan and Chungthang and a permit-based Thangu/Chopta Valley excursion, with Gurudongmar available as an extension.
06:30–17:00 — Breakfast and Gangtok → Mangan → Chungthang → Lachen; check in and allow time to acclimatise.
04:30–16:00 — Early permit-based Thangu/Chopta Valley excursion; Gurudongmar only when approved; return to Lachen for rest.
Gurudongmar: Gangtok → Lachen → Thangu → Gurudongmar → Lachung/Yumthang → Gangtok

A dedicated Gurudongmar Lake journey based around Lachen and Thangu. The very high-altitude excursion is scheduled early and followed by rest; Lachung/Yumthang can be combined when the permit itinerary allows.
06:30–17:00 — Breakfast and transfer from Gangtok to Lachen via Mangan and Chungthang; check in and rest.
04:30–15:00 — Early Lachen → Thangu → Gurudongmar excursion if permitted; return to Lachen and rest.
Pelling Escape: NJP / Bagdogra / Gangtok → Pelling → Skywalk → Pemayangtse → Rabdentse

A compact West Sikkim stay combining Pelling’s Kanchenjunga-facing viewpoints with the Skywalk, Pemayangtse Monastery and Rabdentse Ruins. It is also a useful connection between Gangtok and Darjeeling.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast and full Pelling sightseeing: Skywalk, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse Ruins and selected viewpoints; return for dinner.
Khecheopalri Lake: NJP / Bagdogra / Gangtok → Pelling → Khecheopalri Lake → Pemayangtse → Rabdentse

A slower West Sikkim itinerary built around sacred Khecheopalri Lake, with Pelling’s monasteries and heritage sites added. The forested lake area is best explored without rushing, making this a good nature-and-culture package.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast and drive to Khecheopalri Lake; walk to the lake and spend time in the forested sacred area before returning to Pelling.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Pelling Skywalk, Pemayangtse and Rabdentse sightseeing; return to hotel.
Rabdentse Ruins: NJP / Bagdogra / Gangtok → Pelling → Rabdentse → Pemayangtse → Skywalk

A heritage-focused Pelling package centred on Rabdentse, the former capital of Sikkim, with Pemayangtse Monastery and the Pelling Skywalk. Forest paths, historic ruins and mountain views give the trip a strong culture-and-landscape mix.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, walk to Rabdentse Ruins and explore the historic site, then visit Pemayangtse Monastery.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Pelling Skywalk and additional local sightseeing; evening free in Pelling.
Yuksom: Gangtok / Pelling → Yuksom → Norbugang → Dubdi Monastery

A history-and-nature trip around Yuksom, Sikkim’s traditional first capital and a gateway to trekking routes. Norbugang, Dubdi Monastery, forest paths and village scenery make it ideal for travellers seeking a quieter West Sikkim experience.
08:00–16:00 — Breakfast, visit Norbugang and Dubdi Monastery, then take an easy village/forest walk; return for dinner.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast and optional Khecheopalri/Pelling extension or relaxed Yuksom sightseeing; trekking requires separate planning.
Ravangla & Temi: NJP / Bagdogra / Gangtok → Ravangla → Buddha Park → Temi Tea Garden

A relaxed South Sikkim circuit connecting Ravangla’s Buddha Park with Temi Tea Garden. It suits travellers who want quieter roads, tea-estate scenery and Buddhist landmarks and can be extended towards Namchi or Pelling.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Buddha Park and Ravangla sightseeing, then hotel check-in and rest.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, drive to Temi Tea Garden and explore the tea-estate roads; Namchi/Samdruptse can be added if time permits.
Temi: Gangtok / NJP → Temi Tea Garden → Ravangla / South Sikkim → departure

A short South Sikkim add-on centred on Temi Tea Garden. It works best as a one-night extension from Gangtok or as a connecting stop before Ravangla or Pelling, with an easy pace around tea-estate and village scenery.
08:00–17:00 — Drive to Temi, explore the tea-estate roads and viewpoints, then check in to a South Sikkim stay.
Darjeeling: NJP / Bagdogra / Sikkim → Darjeeling → Tiger Hill → Batasia → Ghoom

A classic Darjeeling hill-station package covering Tiger Hill sunrise, Batasia Loop, Ghoom, Chowrasta and tea-country scenery. The early start is balanced with a relaxed afternoon for cafés, markets and the Mall.
04:00–09:00 — Early Tiger Hill sunrise, Ghoom and Batasia Loop, then breakfast and local sightseeing.
Kalimpong: NJP / Bagdogra / Siliguri → Kalimpong → Deolo → Durpin Dara → departure

A slower Kalimpong hill-town stay focused on viewpoints, heritage and forested landscapes. Deolo and Durpin Dara provide panoramic views, while Morgan House and local monasteries add culture; Relli River or Changey Falls can be added when road time permits.
08:00–17:00 — Breakfast, Deolo Hill, Durpin Dara, Morgan House and local attractions; optional Relli River/Changey Falls if road time permits.
